title: Restore independent restricted-DSL recomputation in guarded Foundry
problem: Blanket child refusal prevents buildable system 16 from reaching its founder ratification gate.
baseline: PR147 bbc0ec61ff2a00faf027733f56841b07efd70f00 integrates guarded Foundry and native media; all six CI jobs passed; child verification is refused.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: One exact reviewed restricted-DSL child protocol, preserving all other refusals; selected.
advantages: Restores independent recomputation without granting arbitrary code execution.
disadvantages: Relies on reviewed Python code and dependencies, not OS filesystem containment.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Changed host isolation or a stronger measured verification mechanism.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Container or microVM execution of general providers.
advantages: Can support a broader original capability horizon under genuine confinement.
disadvantages: Local host probes failed; no supported host facility is currently available.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Working isolation host and escape/resource/revocation tests.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Run exact-recipe verification and five hostile substitution probes through CI.
advantages: Measures runtime reachability while retaining ratification.
disadvantages: Fixtures do not establish live operational acceptance.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder-authorized real use after executable machinery is complete.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: System16 remains unnecessarily unreachable despite restricted DSL implementation.
disadvantages: Violates automatic continuation of buildable machine requirements.

roles.position: Resume the complete machine after a passed increment; system16 remains one dependency, not a product boundary. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: The child could lose the parent's filesystem restrictions.

roles.position: Reuse canonical guarded worker and existing DSL/promotion pipeline with one explicit child protocol. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Module, environment or workspace substitution could change the recipe.

roles.position: Exact recipe matching is necessary; this remains reviewed-code protection, not arbitrary-code containment. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: A child could outlive revocation or exceed the operation budget.

roles.position: Bound child resources and lifetime; preserve staged query disposal and ratification. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Simulation and verification could be mistaken for founder approval or market evidence.

roles.position: Independent recomputation is fixture evidence, not real-world market success or founder acceptance. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: A growing allowlist could quietly authorize unreviewed providers.

evidence.finding: All six job conclusions success at bbc0ec61; local full suite 1678 passed/10 skipped and verifier V1–V5 passed. This evidence does not validate this new delta.
Initial local version passed four focused tests, including 41-case recomputation. The strengthened environment substitution checks and final delta require fresh CI.

They do not. Caller-source and unreviewed child execution remain refused.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Advance system16 through independent recomputation while preserving founder ratification and full-machine continuation.

advantages.amplified_value: Avoids treating a broad host blocker as a reason to freeze restricted, buildable machinery.
No second kernel, secret broker or durable authority.

advantages.statement: Recomputes cases in a separate process
advantages.amplified_value: Detects disagreement with the parent result while retaining evidence limitations.
Revocation, network filter and parent wall budget remain applicable.
A passing fixture cannot promote itself into live authority.

disadvantages.statement: The child could lose the parent's filesystem restrictions.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Install the same reviewed-code guard in the fixed child; retain the explicit absence of an OS filesystem sandbox.

disadvantages.statement: Module, environment or workspace substitution could change the recipe.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require exact interpreter, argv, code-root cwd, PYTHONPATH and parent-installed workspace scope; reject additional environment keys.

disadvantages.statement: A child could outlive revocation or exceed the operation budget.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Inherit seccomp and the parent process group; retain group termination, wall timeout and explicit child CPU, memory and input ceilings.

disadvantages.statement: Simulation and verification could be mistaken for founder approval or market evidence.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Retain the ratification stage and emulated evidence labels; query operations discard all staged writes.

disadvantages.statement: A growing allowlist could quietly authorize unreviewed providers.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Allow only the reviewed dsl-verify recipe and require linked review plus hostile substitution tests before any expansion.
